budget_categories.name: Food & Beverages

suggested_subitems.name: Finger Foods & Live Snack Stalls
suggested_subitems.tip: Chaat counter, nachos bar, cocktail samosas

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: Curate finger-food live stations (mini sliders, chaat, pizza slices) that keep guests mingling.

budget_categories.name: Venue / Party Space
budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: Renting a community clubhouse or rooftop café saves high commercial hall booking charges.

budget_categories.name: Theme Decor, Balloons & Photobooth

suggested_subitems.name: Themed Backdrop & Cake Table Arch
suggested_subitems.tip: Pastel organic balloon garland with LED neon sign

suggested_subitems.name: Interactive Selfie Photobooth
suggested_subitems.tip: Fun props, Polaroid guestbook or instant print

suggested_subitems.name: Table Settings & Paper Goods
suggested_subitems.tip: Coordinated eco-friendly plates, cups and napkins

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: Organic balloon garland arches and reusable neon signage create maximum visual punch at low cost.

budget_categories.name: Cake & Dessert Extravaganza

suggested_subitems.name: Custom Designer Theme Cake
suggested_subitems.tip: Handcrafted fondant or textured buttercream cake

suggested_subitems.name: Cupcakes, Cakepops & Brownies
suggested_subitems.tip: Themed dessert treats for kids and guests

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: A stunning 2-tier designer display cake paired with sheet cakes for slicing cuts costs significantly.

budget_categories.name: Entertainment, Games & Host

suggested_subitems.name: Interactive Emcee / Magician / Host
suggested_subitems.tip: Organized party games, trivia, and prizes

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: An energetic game host or magician keeps both kids and adults thoroughly entertained.

budget_categories.name: Return Favors & Goodie Bags

suggested_subitems.name: Personalized Gift Bags
suggested_subitems.tip: Themed activity kit and gourmet chocolates

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: Give purposeful favors like board games, art kits, or personalized stationery instead of plastic trinkets.

budget_categories.name: Contingency Buffer

suggested_subitems.name: Unforeseen Party Overruns
suggested_subitems.tip: Extra food orders or overtime fees

budget_categories.cost_saving_tip: Covers last-minute additional guests, extra cake portions, or delivery fees.

requirements: FSSAI food-safety certification and minimum 80 pax capacity
Live multi-cuisine stations with separate vegetarian / Jain preparation zones
Uniformed service waitstaff (1 server per 25 guests minimum)
Provision of insulated chaffing dishes and eco-friendly tableware
questions_to_ask: Is a complimentary menu tasting session included prior to contract signing?
What is your exact protocol for surplus unconsumed food?
Do you charge corkage or handling fees for outside beverages?
What is the billing policy if guest count fluctuates by +/- 10% on the day?
comparison_criteria: Per-plate pricing vs taste quality and live presentation
Kitchen hygiene standards and live counter equipment quality
Staff grooming, punctuality track record, and contingency response
vendor_checklist.cautionary_advice: Never pay 100% upfront. Retain 15-20% payable after successful post-event dinner handover.

requirements: 3D layout or sketch of the main stage, mandap, and entrance tunnel
Flame-retardant fabric drape materials and wind-resistant outdoor rigging
Fresh regional marigold, roses, and orchids delivered morning of event
questions_to_ask: Are generator fuel and installation ladder equipment included in the quote?
What happens if bad weather or wind damages outdoor elements?
What is the exact tear-down timeline required by the venue?
comparison_criteria: Portfolio consistency across real weddings vs staged promotional shoots
Transparency in itemized floral counts vs lumped lump-sum costs
Readiness of standby repair crews during the live event
vendor_checklist.cautionary_advice: Verify in writing that artificial synthetic flowers are not substituted for promised fresh floral arrangements.

requirements: Dual-shooter team: 1 traditional portrait photographer + 1 candid artist
4K video capability with dual SD card backup slots on all cameras
Drone operator with local municipal safety and flight permissions
questions_to_ask: Who specifically will be behind the camera on our event day?
What is the exact turnaround timeline for raw photos vs edited 4K highlight reels?
Do you provide raw uncompressed footage on an external SSD?
comparison_criteria: Color grading and natural skin tones in indoor flash lighting
Ability to blend in unobtrusively without blinding guests with continuous lights
vendor_checklist.cautionary_advice: Insist on naming the actual photographers in the contract. Some agencies outsource bookings to untested freelance juniors.

requirements: Minimum 5kW professional JBL / RCF active speaker array
At least 4 wireless handheld UHF microphones with fresh batteries
questions_to_ask: Do you carry an emergency backup mixer, spare laptop, and extra cables?
Will you accept a family 'Must-Play' and 'Do-Not-Play' song playlist?
Are stage cold pyros and smoke haze included in the sound package?
comparison_criteria: Crowd engagement and ability to read room energy across age groups
Seamless audio transitions without awkward dead silences
Clarity of vocal announcements without audio feedback screeches
vendor_checklist.cautionary_advice: Confirm local outdoor music curfew laws (typically 10:00 PM) to avoid sound confiscation or police fines.

requirements: On-location greenroom presence with professional ring light setup
questions_to_ask: Can we schedule a paid or complimentary look trial 3 weeks prior?
Does the quote include hair extensions, false lashes, and fresh floral accessories?
How many assistants will accompany you for mother-of-the-bride / bridesmaids?
comparison_criteria: Longevity of makeup under heavy stage lighting and perspiration
Punctuality record for early morning muhurat / party schedules
Cleanliness of cosmetic brushes and hygienic beauty blenders
vendor_checklist.cautionary_advice: Block your artist with an advance receipt early. High-demand wedding muhurat dates get triple-booked.

assumptions_and_disclosures: All budget line items are mathematically calculated in application code based on ₹150,000.00 total allocation.
Prices and cost ranges reflect prevailing regional market benchmarks for reputable vendors and may vary with seasonal wedding muhurats.
Contingency safety reserve (5-7%) is kept uncommitted to absorb overtime fees and surprise guest arrivals.
Vendor checklist items highlight comparison criteria and negotiation guidelines; no unverified private businesses are falsely promoted.
